correctness.rationale: In the normalized Weyl basis W_w/sqrt(d), each measurement column is a symplectic character times an ambiguity scalar divided by sqrt(d); nondegeneracy of the pairing over Z/p² makes distinct columns orthogonal and gives column norm sqrt(d)|A(w)|. With the stated g, the resulting singular value is the modulus of the unnormalized character sum over the translated intersection. Its defining equation 2ut=v+u² gives one point for unit u, a coset of pR for nonzero u in pR and v in pR, and no points at other nonzero displacements. On the coset the top digit cancels except when r+2st0=0 mod p, giving p modulus in p⁴(p-1) directions. At zero displacement split t=t0+pj: the j-sum vanishes unless r+2st0=0 mod p. For unit s this leaves exactly one t0 and modulus p; when p divides s it leaves none if p does not divide r and otherwise reduces to p times the mod-p sum, with modulus p^(3/2) for nonzero s/p and p² only at the origin. The mod-p modulus follows by additive orthogonality after a difference substitution using 2s/p invertible. Thus p⁴(p-1)+(p⁴-p³)=p⁵-p³ for the p band, and the other band and zero counts, the rank and the restricted condition number follow. Independent p=3,5 exact integer cyclotomic reduction matched every band (including 1964 and 75104 zero directions) and the squared-spectrum trace p⁸.
residual_risks: Finite exact checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite family; the algebraic case split does. The result does not address nonlinear recovery of pure states.

evidence: Gram eigenvalues and squared measurement singular values are equivalent, with eigenvalue d|A|²; the full ambiguity magnitude table is thus equivalent to the full spectrum when indexed in Weyl coordinates.

value.rationale: For a natural prime-power analogue of a standard finite-field window, the computation quantifies linear identifiability, states exactly which Weyl modes are lost, and gives conditioning on the observable part. The new band explains an observable ring/field difference despite identical ambient cardinality. It is stronger than a rank estimate or a restriction moment.
residual_risks: No general p^m, m>2, or broader class of windows is established.
